stem_book: Find the sum of the accelerations of the two blocks (in m/s²). A 10 kg block rests on another 10 kg block, which rests on a smooth floor; μ = 0.5 between the blocks. A horizontal force of 101 N acts on the upper block and 50 N on the lower block, both in the same direction. The system is initially at rest. (g = 10 m/s²)
work: Common a = 151/20 = 7.55; friction needed on upper = 101 − 10·7.55 = 25.5 N < μmg = 50 N → no slip; sum = 15.1 m/s²
